summary: Western Union filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a further issuance of $4.750% Notes due 2029, reopening an existing $450 million series. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing senior debt. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by Wells Fargo Securities on a T+1 settlement basis. No special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
